## The question

> What are the free tools that are actually worth using?

**The walkaway:**

> Every free tool is paid for in one of four ways. Ask who pays before you sign up.

| 1 | 0:00.0 | hook | 4.0 | Nothing on the internet is free. But some free things are genuinely worth it. | Genuinely free? |

| 4 | 0:14.0 | step-by-step | 10.0 | You pay with attention. Or with data. Or later. Or somebody else pays. | The four ways |
| 5 | 0:24.0 | explain | 7.0 | Ads mean the product is your attention. The tool is just the delivery. | You pay with attention |
